You can source used chemical reactors through industrial surplus marketplaces like [Surplus Record](https://surplusrecord.com/machinery-equipment/reactors/) or specialized process equipment dealers such as [Federal Equipment Company](https://fedequip.com/inventory/reactors), [Aaron Equipment](https://www.aaronequipment.com/equipment/reactors) , and [International Process Plants](https://internationalprocessplants.com/process-equipment/reactor/).[[1]](https://fedequip.com/inventory/reactors)[[2]](https://surplusrecord.com/machinery-equipment/reactors/)[[3]](https://ims.internationalprocessplants.com/inventory/equipment/reactor)

### Popular Dealers & Marketplaces

- **Federal Equipment Company:** Stocks over 225 used reactors ranging from small pilot sizes to large production volumes, including stainless steel, carbon steel, glass-lined, and exotic alloy builds.[[1]](https://fedequip.com/inventory/reactors)
- **EquipNet:** Global inventory features reactors, bioreactors, and single-use systems from major brands like De Dietrich, Chemglass, and Sartorius with capacities spanning 4L to 64,000L.[[1]](https://www.equipnet.com/category/reactors-20860575/)
- **Phoenix Equipment:** Carries jacketed, non-jacketed, and internally-coiled models sourced from top manufacturers like American Alloy and Precision Stainless.[[1]](https://www.phxequip.com/category/42/reactors)
- **Surplus Record & Bid on Equipment:** Online listing directories featuring individual secondhand units—such as a 300-gallon stainless steel agitated reactor or larger 1,500-gallon polymerization vessels.[[1]](https://www.bid-on-equipment.com/lv/reactors?srsltid=AU7gw4W-dNMOv9n_CYDM1gPw9N0JiOaRnudiNmIBAxbkfBrTTUYtVJGg)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:17090826565181183945&ibp=oshop)

### Key Specifications to Verify

- **Material of Construction:** Stainless steel (304, 316L), glass-lined (enamel), or exotic alloys (Hastelloy, Titanium, Monel) depending on your chemical compatibility needs.
- **Thermal Management:** Jacketed walls or internal coils for heating and cooling control.
- **Pressure & Vacuum Ratings:** ASME code stamp verification and National Board registration numbers.
- **Agitation:** Motor horsepower, drive type (e.g., Lightnin), and seal configuration.[[1]](https://www.lcec.us/reactors-vessels/)[[2]](https://fedequip.com/inventory/reactors)[[3]](https://www.3diequipment.com/equipment/used/reactors/)[[4]](https://sigmaprocessequipment.com/reactors/)[[5]](https://www.phxequip.com/category/42/reactors)[[6]](https://surplusrecord.com/machinery-equipment/reactors/)[[7]](https://surplusrecord.com/machinery-equipment/reactors/page/2/?sort=date_added&field_seq0_low&field_seq0_high&new_equipment%5B0%5D&q&listings-per-page=50)

To help narrow down the right reactor for your facility, please share:

- Your required **capacity range** (in gallons or liters)
- The **material of construction** or chemical compatibility needed
- Whether you need a **jacketed vessel** or integrated **agitator/mixer**
